question: How long does the heat shock last?
notes: First phrasing tried: 'For how many seconds is the tube kept in the 42 °C water bath during the heat shock?'. Flat attention answered '45 seconds', structured attention (sequence of the Heat shock section) answered '42'; three other phrasings all gave '45 seconds' in structured mode. Kept as a known model-quality observation, not a mechanism failure.
